{icon:bullet,1.2} When you form or consume a Corpse you gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]%{/c} Damage Reduction for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds. 
{icon:bullet,1.2} Enemies Close to your Corpses are inflicted with {c_important}Decrepify{/c} and {c_important}Iron Maiden{/c}.
